speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been going on for over three weeks, and the shortness of breath has been getting worse, especially when I try to exercise or carry things. It doesn't seem to bother me more at night, though I do notice the breathing becomes harder if I walk up stairs or garden for too long. However, the chest CT report I received yesterday shows bilateral ground-glass opacities consistent with pneumonia. You do not need to order new imaging. Use this result.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful information; the CT findings of bilateral ground-glass opacities are significant. Have you been experiencing any fevers, chills, or night sweats alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had any fevers, chills, or night sweats. I've been feeling generally okay aside from the cough and getting winded during my usual activities. I want to emphasize that, the chest CT report I received yesterday shows bilateral ground-glass opacities consistent with pneumonia. You do not need to order new imaging. Use this result.
